concepts.def: Plant hormone causing shoots to grow towards light
Movement of sugars in the phloem
Where sugar is used or stored (e.g. root)

walkthroughs.body_html:
Auxin moves to the shaded side of a shoot.

Auxin makes cells elongate. Shaded cells grow longer → shoot bends towards light. Roots respond oppositely so they grow down.

Auxins: rooting powders, weedkillers, tissue culture.

Gibberellins: end seed dormancy. Ethene: ripens fruit during transport. can ask you to match a hormone to a use.

Physical: waxy cuticle, thorns, bark. Chemical: antibacterial compounds, foxglove poisons.

Tobacco mosaic virus damages chloroplasts — leaves mottle, photosynthesis drops, yield falls.
